preconditions.expression: all(0 <= B[i][j] <= 5000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix B are between 0 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N for _ in range(Q))
preconditions.description: Each query's p is between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= F[i] <= 5000 for i in range(N) for _ in range(Q))
preconditions.description: Each query's Fi is between 0 and 5000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output[i].split()) == N for i in range(Q + 1))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output contains N space-separated integers.
The first element of the initial sequence is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(int(output[i].split()[j]) - int(output[i].split()[k])) == B[j][k] for i in range(Q + 1) for j in range(N) for k in range(N))
postconditions.description: For each output sequence, the absolute difference between any two elements matches the corresponding value in the matrix B.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] <= output[i + 1] for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: Each subsequent sequence is lexicographically greater than or equal to the previous one.
